WITH order_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    orderslink,
    AVG(rebtotal) as avg_rebtotal,
    AVG(feerate - rebrate) as avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM fees
  GROUP BY orderslink
),
overall_avg_net_fee AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(feerate - rebrate) as overall_avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM fees
),
above_average_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    os.avg_rebtotal,
    os.avg_net_fee_rate,
    (os.avg_net_fee_rate - oaf.overall_avg_net_fee_rate) as excess
  FROM order_stats os
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg_net_fee oaf
  WHERE os.avg_net_fee_rate > oaf.overall_avg_net_fee_rate
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_rebtotal) as mean_avg_rebtotal,
  AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) as mean_avg_net_fee_rate,
  AVG(excess) as mean_excess
FROM above_average_orders

assumptions.assumption: The 'overall average net fee rate' is calculated from all individual fee records' net fee rates (AVG(feerate - rebrate) across all rows), not from the average of order-level average net fee rates

alternatives.interpretation: The 'overall average net fee rate' is the average of all orders' average net fee rates, weighting each order equally rather than by its fee count
